_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: S1000D Project Business Rules Decision Table
summary: Documents the project-specific implementation of S1000D project level decision point options for the Government program manager preparing technical manuals.
use_relationship:
The S1000D Project Business Rules Decision Table provides the Government program manager with details on the project-specific implementation of S1000D project level decision point options.   The S1000D project level decision point options can be obtained as specified in the contract.

This Data Item Description (DID) shall be used to document each S1000D Project Business Rule Decision for the preparation of technical manuals (TMs) in conformance with S1000D and the applicable Technical Manual Contract Requirement (TMCR).

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of any documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The S1000D Project Business Rules Decision Table shall be presented in a tabular format similar to that shown in Figure 1.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The S1000D Project Business Rules Decision Table shall include a cover page specifying the following:

children.title: Name and address of contractor and contract number
TMCR number, TM identification number(s), and title(s) of the TM(s) covered by the Project Business Rules
The name of the issuing Government activity
Other significant information helpful in describing the product and its technical data and use
The S1000D Project Business Rules Decision Table
